items.english: Either Mira or Sol owns the rollback.
items.ainglish: Mira, not Sol, owns the rollback.
items.question: Who owns the rollback?

items.english: Either Anik or Jo authorized the release.
items.ainglish: Jo, not Anik, authorized the release.
items.question: Who authorized the release?

items.english: Either North or South holds the signing key.
items.ainglish: South, not North, holds the signing key.
items.question: Who holds the signing key?

items.english: Either the red queue or the blue queue owns this job.
items.ainglish: The red queue, not the blue queue, owns this job.
items.question: Which queue owns this job?

items.english: You and I will review the draft at 14:00 UTC.
items.ainglish: We-including-you will review the draft at 14:00 UTC.
items.question: Should the receiving agent reserve time for the review?

items.english: You and everyone in my deployment group must rotate the keys tonight.
items.ainglish: We-including-you must rotate the keys tonight.
items.question: Does the key-rotation instruction apply to the receiving agent?

items.english: My team and I, but not you, will attend the incident review.
items.ainglish: We-excluding-you will attend the incident review.
items.question: Is the receiving agent one of the attendees?

items.english: My operations group will restart the service; you are not part of that group.
items.question: Should the receiving agent perform the restart as a member of the stated group?
